facts.text: I'm Arthur, I'm rich, and I'm having a lovely time. Hobson, bring the car around, and bring a sandwich.
facts.why: Not an Arthur line. The quote page has 'I'm going to take a bath.' and 'No, I have remained drunk since our last encounter.' Printed in quote marks and signed Arthur Bach.
facts.fix: I'm going to take a bath.

facts.text: Hobson the butler, keeping Arthur's world properly civilised
facts.why: Wikipedia calls Hobson Arthur's valet, and Arthur introduces him as 'my nanny'. 'Butler' is not confirmed. The wink 'Hobson, the butler with the driest wit' has the same word.
facts.fix: Hobson the valet, keeping Arthur's world properly civilised

facts.why: The plot sources describe a rich New York family, a chauffeured Rolls-Royce and the family estate, but never a penthouse.

facts.text: Arthur's usual, Hobson pouring with a sigh.
facts.why: Arthur drinks heavily, but no source names single malt and soda as his usual.
No source says Arthur drinks Kir royale.
facts.fix: Champagne cocktail for the man with a hundred and fifty million coming.

vibe.verdict: Elegant and dry, but Arthur's best-known moments are missing.
missing: The bubble bath in the top hat
Burt Johnson drawing a cheese knife at the church
Martha's $750 million offer at the end
ideas: Swap 'Crème brûlée' for a 'Cheese knife board', note 'Burt Johnson brings his own.'
Swap 'Hobson's cucumber and cress sandwiches' note for 'I'll alert the media.'
Swap 'Arthur's Kir royale' for a 'Bubble bath martini' in a glass with a cocktail onion.
Change the cue to 'Serve dessert when Arthur says he is taking a bath and Hobson replies he will alert the media.'
